name: Genmo
tagline: Genmo is an AI video generation platform and the team behind Mochi 1, an open-source video generation model known for high-motion clips and fluid character movement. Researchers and creators can run Mochi 1 locally from the open-source weights, or use Genmo's consumer app to generate videos from text prompts without any setup. It is one of the more technically capable open-source video models available.
